name: Rau rừng
summary: Rau rừng is forest greens, boiled or in soup, with the seafood rice. A 2026 note still dips rau dớn, rau sân, rau lủi, and mã đề in mắm cái with chili and garlic, while a 2025 account says that sauce is now rare.
origin: Cham Islands. Forest and garden greens on Tân Hiệp, eaten with the catch.
howToEat: In soup, or boiled, with the midday or evening rice. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00 on the 16 September 2025 study.

A 3 March 2026 note names rau dớn, rau sân, rau lủi, and mã đề among more than 16 leaves, boiled and dipped in mắm cái with chili and garlic. A 16 September 2025 account lists mắm cái among foods people rarely use now. Both stay.
seoTitle: Rau rừng — island greens, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Forest greens in soup or boiled, with the seafood rice on Tân Hiệp. One note still dips them in mắm cái. Another says that sauce is now rare.
